features.text: DownloadFileWithFormat: Exports the document into the specified format. (GET /diagram/{name})
CreateNew: Create Empty file into the specified format. (PUT /diagram/{name})
ConvertDocument: Converts document from the request's content to the specified format. (PUT /diagram/{name}/convert)
SaveAs: Converts document to destination format with detailed settings and saves result to storage. (POST /diagram/{name}/saveAs)
PutDrawLine: draw line on the page. (PUT /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/drawLine)
PutDrawEllipse: draw ellipse on the page. (PUT /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/drawEllipse)
PutDrawPolyline: draw polyline on the page. (PUT /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/drawPolyline)
GetFonts: Read fonts info. (GET /diagram/{name}/fonts)
ChangeFontName: Change font (PUT /diagram/{name}/fonts/{fontName})
ReplaceFont: Replaces a source font with a target font across the entire document. (POST /diagram/{name}/fonts/replace)
GetPageFonts: Returns the fonts actually used on a specific page. (GET /diagram/{name}/fonts/pages/{pageName})
ChangePageFontName: Applies a single font to all text on the specified page. (PUT /diagram/{name}/fonts/pages/{pageName}/{fontName})
AddMaster: Add master shapes by uploading a visio file. (PUT /diagram/{name}/masters/upload)
AddExistMaster: Add master shapes from an existing master file on cloud storage (PUT /diagram/{name}/masters)
GetMasters: Get the existing master shapes in the document (GET /diagram/{name}/masters)
GetPages: Read pages info. (GET /diagram/{name}/pages)
PutNewPage: Add new empty page (PUT /diagram/{name}/pages/addNew)
PostPageSetup: page setup (POST /diagram/{name}/pages/PageSetup)
DeletePage: Remove Page (DELETE /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName})
AddShapes: Add shapes on the page(If the current file does not have a master, you need to add the require Master of a Shape). (PUT /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/shapes)
GetShapes: Get shapes on the page (GET /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/shapes)
UpdateShape: Update shape on the page by shape id. (POST /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/shapes)
DeleteShapes: Delete shapes on the page (DELETE /diagram/{name}/pages/{pageName}/shapes/{shapeId})
